final_message: You know how to move goods, build a crew, give orders, and hit a target. Intermediate suppliers and the base workbench are now available. From here, the operation is yours to grow.

missions.title: First Run
missions.description: Open Phone > Market and place a buy order for Fast Food. Benji can carry one small load.

missions.title: Stock the House
missions.description: Let Benji finish the trip. The order is complete when the goods reach storage.

missions.title: Make the Sale
missions.description: Use Phone > Market to sell Fast Food, then wait for Benji to return with the cash.

missions.title: Hire Protection
missions.description: Open Phone > Hire and recruit one Muscle candidate. Trade earnings pay the hiring cost.

missions.title: Take Control
missions.description: Give your combat crew an order with 1 Follow, 2 Attack, or 3 Hold.

missions.title: Hit the Depot
missions.description: Open Phone > Raids and complete the Abandoned Depot raid. Join the crew or send them without you.
